items.title: Sadio Mané to Lay Foundation Stone for 11 Billion CFA Franc Agro-Industrial Park in Bambali
items.summary: By Staff Writer Senegalese football star Sadio Mané will, on Saturday, Sept. 19, lay the foundation stone for an 11 billion CFA franc agro-industrial park in his hometown of Bambali, in Senegal’s southern Sédhiou region. The project, known as SM10 Agro, is expected to create a...
